integrity: A mathematical argument and a standalone finite verifier are included. Finite tests are corroborative and do not establish the infinite-family theorem.
scientific_limitations: The underlying nonequivariant homotopy classification, including both sphere counts, is already Proposition 41 of Carnero Bravo (2023). The new results classify the integral automorphism modules using a natural equivariant cover; no equivariant homotopy splitting or independently established publication priority is claimed.
title: Integral symmetry modules of crown-graph induced-forest complexes
